reviewer_statement: Scoped source scientific data and plotting-artist developer review. Native R registered trajectories/warp geometry and direct pinned Python 1.2 source artist comparisons are committed. Exact-head differential CI and external certification are not yet verified; native R cannot return Python Matplotlib Axes/Figure instances.
native_language_semantic_policy: Only observed scientific line coordinates, figure panel count/metadata, source labels/opacity and source identity/displacement definitions are represented. The native base graphics object is not Python Matplotlib, and exception/axes mutation/pixel parity remain out of scope.

case_evidence.description: Frozen public Python 1.2 src/eyetrajectoriespy/plotting.py::plot_warping_functions. No R implementation reuses Python runtime plotting classes.

Native genuine completed landmark registration with finite original-time warp matrices, exact curve/time axes and a scalar Boolean displacement. Strict mode must be Boolean, and Matplotlib external ax injection is not supported by native R.

One source line per fitted curve in original order, x=original time and y=h(t) or h(t)-t with alpha=.3. When displacement=FALSE, a source dashed diagonal identity y=t labelled identity is present and legend shown; when TRUE, zero horizontal reference is present without legend. Source axes labels and public frozen Python Matplotlib line coordinates/alpha directly compared.

Malformed registration, incomplete or nonfinite original warp, nonlogical displacement and strict flag are refused. R base graphics error class differs from Python matplotlib, and optional Python ax injection is not implemented.

Python returns Matplotlib Axes with Line2D warps and source identity or horizontal reference. Native strict R returns one-panel numerical source artist geometry, title/axes/labels and legend intent. Legacy native R returns original warp data frame; Python runtime classes and pixel rendering are outside source-scoped contract.
Actual fitted landmark time deformation h(t) or h(t)-t for each source curve with correct identity/zero comparison, without replacing fitted warp arrays.

independent_review_status: Author-scoped provisional scientific-geometry review; pinned Python exact-head tests queued/unverified, zero independent certifications.
language_specific_limits: R base graphics and source data do not recreate Python Figure/Axes runtime object identity, exceptions, or pixel-equivalent rendering.
Supported source-scientific geometry scope is restricted to complete native registration and original observed reconstruction summary; full Python input/ax domain remains different.
No independently checked numerical end-to-end registration certification, main-branch merge or CRAN qualification asserted.
